keySeparationEvaluation.futureMigrationRequirement: A separate signing key requires explicit key versioning/verifier selection and a controlled migration before cutover.

review.privateKeyReferenceScan: PASSOU: no direct private-key references or key-pair export remain in TefManager/NativeHost.

limitations: No official database was opened, so compatibility was validated with frozen RELEASE/COMMIT fixtures signed by the prior derivation under the matching test key.
The unrelated AES development fallback in cryptoService remains; it is not used by the Ed25519 signer.
A future dedicated signing secret requires an explicit migration/key-versioning design and was not introduced.
